name: Remote Desktop
description: Browser-side remote desktop client (noVNC over a raw WebSocket→TCP byte bridge), with a Hosts settings panel to add/edit/remove saved machines. Ported from the aw monolith (src/api/routes/remote_desktop.py + RemoteDesktopWindow.jsx), moving the flat remote_desktop.json config into this app's OWN Postgres table (app__rdp-vnc__hosts) with real per-app SQL migrations, and host passwords into the workspace secret store instead of a file encrypted with the monolith's key.

default_scaling.description: How the noVNC viewport fits the window: scale (fit locally), remote (ask the server to resize its desktop), none (1:1 with scrollbars).

view_only.description: Open every session read-only — the remote desktop is rendered but keyboard/mouse input is not forwarded.

connect_timeout_s.description: Seconds to wait for the TCP connection to a host before the bridge gives up and closes the WebSocket with code 4502.
